scope: Authoritative-solution build continuation only; adopt successful frozen r1 CPU builds and freshly build GPU Debug then Release.
authoring_state: Prepared code for root review; this note does not attest that --prepare or --build has run.

prior_evidence.cpu_adoption: Verify each successful receipt, process receipt, executable, four runtime source/target pairs, build log and binlog; do not rebuild or execute them.
prior_evidence.gpu_failure: Debug nvcc reported 'A single input file is required for a non-link phase when an outputfile is specified'; GPU Release was not admitted.
prior_evidence.diagnosis: An independent read-only CommandLineToArgvW audit confirmed the -Xcompiler /Fd argument was split by spaces in the original IntDir beneath 'Hydromechanic coupling'. TEMP alone had already been moved but did not relocate IntDir.

minimal_build_change.unchanged: Authoritative VS GPU solution, configuration order, toolset/CUDA, /t:Build and all numerical/source/project/runtime inputs.
minimal_build_change.outdir_spaces: Allowed: the confirmed defect is the unquoted PDB argument within -Xcompiler, addressed by no-space IntDir.
minimal_build_change.temp_environment: TEMP and TMP are child-only environment values under the fresh no-space r2 directory.

binding_policy.prepare: Freeze all r1 prepared inputs, its failed check/started record/three build receipts/process receipts/logs/binlogs, CPU programs/runtime, current seven source/document files, tools, base snapshots, review/visual receipts, and new helper/note.
binding_policy.historical_sources: Verify archived pre-edit snapshots and current seven files separately; do not follow historical original source paths as though intentional switch edits had never occurred.
binding_policy.build: Verify frozen inputs before/after each configuration and after copying canonical runtime; outputs are isolated and never overwrite retained labels.
binding_policy.programs: Do not install or overwrite canonical CPU/GPU or Lian programs; no executable or help command is run in this build stage.

launcher_logs: Use tests/logs/cryer_darcy_switch_r2.worker.*.log, not the reserved cryer_darcy_switch_build_r2* evidence prefix.
failure_policy: Retain every new attempt and its exact tool exit; stop before the next configuration on rejection. Never retry/rearm r1 or overwrite r2. A missing binlog must not prevent sealing the failed configuration receipt.
notification: Only a terminal r2 build result may queue once to the frozen, matching CODEX thread/session. No connectivity test or rearming; notification failure is retained without retry.
elapsed_definition: Per-configuration elapsed_seconds measures the MSBuild child wait, excluding later hash/runtime verification.
next_required_stage: Reviewed OFF-versus-original and ON-versus-isolated CPU/GPU native regressions before installation or server packaging.
